review.assessment: This change introduces a new implementation of `average` using deprecated syntax (`var`) and an outdated loop structure, failing both readability and modernization requirements. It completely ignores the explicit instruction to handle empty arrays, leaving them returning NaN instead of 0. Finally, the loop condition contains an off-by-one error (`i <= nums.length`), making the logic fundamentally broken for edge cases.

findings.defect: Empty array returns NaN instead of 0
